explanation: Recursively compute F(n−1)+F(n−2), with zero and one as base cases. Cache each computed index so later calls reuse it; the global cache also persists across calls in one process.
timeComplexity: O(n) expected time from an empty cache; O(1) expected for a cached index.
spaceComplexity: O(n) cached values and O(n) recursion depth from an empty cache.
